title: 花旗权益交易收入创新：超预期21%，为何股价反跌1%？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The big banks are clearly seeing the even small gains, small beats, not enough to get the job done.
segments.zh: 大型银行显然看到，即使是小幅增长、小幅超预期，也不足以完成任务。

segments.en: Get another beat, but this is a small one from City Group.
segments.zh: 花旗集团再次超预期，但这次幅度很小。

segments.en: Second quarter, equity sales and training revenue 2.3 billion, the estimate 1.9 might sound large.
segments.zh: 第二季度权益销售和交易收入23亿美元，预期19亿，听起来差距不小。

segments.en: But compared to what we've seen elsewhere, that is a small beat. If you're looking at fixed sales and training revenue at a city this morning, 4.71 billion, the estimate 4.56, that's a nice upside surprise.
segments.zh: 但与之前看到的相比，这只是小幅超预期。花旗固定收益销售和交易收入47.1亿，预期45.6亿，这是个不错的惊喜。

segments.en: That won't get it done this morning. Sit you in the pre-market, down 1%.
segments.zh: 但这在今天早上还不够。盘前交易中，花旗股价下跌1%。

segments.en: Yet, the bar has been reset for banking stocks. If you don't report some sort of not only a revenue beat, but some sort of 80, 70% increase year
segments.zh: 然而，银行股的门槛已被重新设定。如果你不报告收入超预期，或者季度权益交易销售额同比增长80%或70%以上，

segments.en: over year in quarterly equity trading sales, or some sort of astronomical, superlative type of quarter, you're not going to attract a lot of those investors.
segments.zh: 或者某种天文数字般的超级季度，你就无法吸引那些市场参与者。

segments.en: And that just really feeds into what we've seen all morning, which is essentially, you have to beat so astronomically high to even have your shares go up in any kind of way.
segments.zh: 这正印证了我们今早看到的情况：你必须超预期得极其惊人，股价才能有所上涨。

segments.en: Again, really speaking to that, because ultimately they beat across the board, markets revenue $7 billion versus $6.45, wealth revenue $3.2 versus $3.07.
segments.zh: 再次强调这一点，因为最终他们全面超预期：市场收入70亿对64.5亿，财富收入32亿对30.7亿。

segments.en: All of these, BPP, just not enough. It's not a judgment on the quality of the quarter, or the execution of the management team, and everyone working at say the likes of city.
segments.zh: 所有这些，还是不够。这不是对季度质量或管理团队执行力的评判，也不是对花旗员工的评判。

segments.en: These are great numbers and we've seen them elsewhere. This is about how the market is choosing to reward or punish those numbers so far this morning.
segments.zh: 这些数字很亮眼，其他公司也有类似表现。关键在于市场今早如何选择奖励或惩罚这些数据。

segments.en: You mentioned a bunch of numbers there. That interesting come for the second quarter, 17.13 billion.
segments.zh: 你提到了一串数字。第二季度营收171.3亿美元，很有意思。

segments.en: The estimate was 16.01. It's a really nice beat from city.
segments.zh: 预期是160.1亿，花旗实际表现远超预期。

segments.en: I don't see any misses here.
segments.zh: 我看不到任何不及预期的地方。
